macros.name: APomit
macros.doc: Used in an \item to signify that that item should not be automatically punctuated, and not be counted.

macros.name: enableAPautopassnest
macros.doc: Automatically put an \APpass on items that introduce a nested list.

macros.name: setAPall
macros.doc: Set all punctuation points the same.

macros.name: setAPeach
macros.doc: Set the default, second last, and last punctuation point in that order.
